import itertools
# regions over universe elements typed by membership in (C,P,L,M); enumerate models with small universes
types=list(itertools.product([0,1],repeat=4))
ok={'I':True,'II':True,'III':True}
found=False
for n in range(1,4):
  for model in itertools.product(types,repeat=n):
    C=lambda e:e[0];P=lambda e:e[1];L=lambda e:e[2];M=lambda e:e[3]
    if not any(C(e) for e in model): continue  # nonempty terms
    if not all(P(e) for e in model if C(e)): continue
    if not any(P(e) and L(e) for e in model): continue
    if not all(M(e) for e in model if L(e)): continue
    found=True
    ok['I']&=any(P(e) and C(e) for e in model)
    ok['II']&=any(L(e) and P(e) for e in model)
    ok['III']&=any(M(e) and L(e) for e in model)
assert found
res=frozenset(k for k,v in ok.items() if v)
opts={'A':frozenset({'II','III'}),'B':frozenset({'III'}),'C':frozenset({'I','III'}),'D':frozenset({'I','II','III'})}
assert res==opts['D']
assert all(res!=v for k,v in opts.items() if k!='D')
steps: All C are P and C non-empty so some P are C (I)
Some P are L converts to some L are P (II)
Some L exist and all L are M, so some M are L (III)

import itertools
# universe of element types over (computer,printer,laptop,mobile) membership; enumerate models via nonempty type subsets
types=[t for t in itertools.product([0,1],repeat=4)]
# c,p,l,m
ok=lambda t:(not t[0] or t[1]) and (not t[2] or t[3])
types=[t for t in types if ok(t)]
res=[True,True,True]
for r in range(1,len(types)+1):
    for S in itertools.combinations(types,r):
        if not any(t[1] and t[2] for t in S): continue
        # need computers nonempty for I? 'All computers are printers' carries no existence; test both
        c1=any(t[0] and t[1] for t in S)
        c2=any(t[2] and t[1] for t in S)
        c3=any(t[3] and t[2] for t in S)
        res=[res[0] and c1,res[1] and c2,res[2] and c3]
# I needs computers to exist; standard convention assumes existence
assert res[1] and res[2]
res1_conv=True  # standard convention: All A are B implies Some B are A
concl=(res1_conv,res[1],res[2])
ans={'A':(False,True,True),'B':(False,False,True),'C':(True,False,True),'D':(True,True,True)}
assert [k for k,v in ans.items() if v==concl]==['D']

import itertools
types=list(itertools.product([0,1],repeat=4)) # t,c,l,b
types=[x for x in types if (not x[1] or x[2]) and not (x[2] and x[3])]
def check(f):
    for r in range(1,len(types)+1):
        for S in itertools.combinations(types,r):
            if not any(x[0] and x[1] for x in S): continue
            if not f(S): return False
    return True
I=check(lambda S: all(not x[2] or x[0] for x in S))
II=check(lambda S: not any(x[3] and x[2] for x in S))
